item.title: Gemini Probes Paper
item.description: This is a paper readalong for arxiv.org/pdf/2601.11516 AI safety is more important than ever, with models having increased capabilities. One way to detect misuse of LLMs is with monitoring systems. If we can catch bad user inputs, then we can mitigate them. Gemini probes is a way to monitor such misuse. WTF are probes? Imagine a neuroscientist sticking a multimeter into your head to read your brain’s neurons to determine if you have evil thoughts.
